quotes.author: Tour Adventure
quotes.text: Tour AdventureOn January 23, my husband and I took a guided Kayak tour with a company named Adventure Kayak Cocoa Beach. As it turns out it was an Adventure! It started at 401 Ramp Road in Cocoa Beach seating on a two – seater kayak. Our guide, Dan, prepared us with instructions on how to maneuver the kayak. What followed was truly unexpected. Pelican sightings, Dolphins feasting and Mangrove Tunnels!I want to thank Dan for not only all the information that he provided but for his calm guidance. A beautiful and Relaxing two hours with fantastic photo memories.

One of the highlights of our trip!We had a wonderful time using adventure, kayak of Cocoa Beach. Our tour guide was awesome and the experience was amazing. Never seen anything like this. We did a nighttime tour and it was the best decision ever especially during the summer heat. The bioluminescence was awesome. A fish even jumped in my kayak and we were able to catch jellyfish with small nets. Our entire family of five thoroughly enjoyed it. We would definitely do this again.
